title: parse_angle_addr breaks on ESMTP parameters (SIZE, ORCPT)
description: Trigger: any MTA sending 'MAIL FROM:<sender@example.com> SIZE=12345' or 'RCPT TO:<alice@example.com> ORCPT=rfc822;alice@example.com'. parse_angle_addr uses strip_prefix('<').and_then(|s| s.strip_suffix('>')): strip_suffix fails because the string ends with the ESMTP param, not '>'. Falls through to return the raw string including angle brackets and params. Effects: (1) envelope_from = '<sender@example.com> SIZE=12345' — breaks SPF domain extraction in auth.rs:rfc5321_domain rsplit_once('@') which returns 'com> SIZE=12345'. (2) RCPT TO with params: to_addr = '<alice@example.com> ORCPT=...' — eq_ignore_ascii_case fails user lookup → 550 for valid configured user. SIZE on MAIL FROM is sent by virtually all modern MTAs. Fix: find the angle-bracketed portion first, strip everything after the closing '>'
